class ConnectomeSparsity(nn.Module):
    """Learn connectivity topology, not individual weights (all weights = Wsyn)"""
    def __init__(self, n_neurons, sparsity=0.008):  # 1M/127k² ≈ 0.008
        super().__init__()
        self.Wsyn = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.275))
        self.topology = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n_neurons, n_neurons))
        self.sparsity = sparsity
    def forward(self, x):
        # Gumbel-softmax for differentiable topology selection
        mask = (torch.rand_like(self.topology) < self.sparsity).float()
        return x @ (mask * torch.sign(self.topology) * F.softplus(self.Wsyn))

class CircadianOscillatorLayer(nn.Module):
    """Neural layer with built-in oscillations via regulatory feedback"""
    def __init__(self, features):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(features, features))
        self.W_neg = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(features, features))
        self.lambda_act = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(features) * 2.0)
        self.lambda_rep = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(features) * -1.5)
        self.delta = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(features) * 0.1)
    def g(self, u):
        return u / (1 + u**2)
    def forward(self, x, state_pos, state_neg):
        reg_signal = self.lambda_act * state_pos + self.lambda_rep * state_neg
        modulated = self.g(reg_signal)
        d_pos = F.relu(x @ self.W_pos) * modulated - self.delta * state_pos
        new_pos = state_pos + d_pos
        d_neg = F.relu(new_pos @ self.W_neg) - self.delta * state_neg
        new_neg = state_neg + d_neg
        return new_pos, new_neg

class CompartmentalLayer(nn.Module):
    """Neurons with spatial extent - multiple compartments per neuron"""
    def __init__(self, n_neurons, n_compartments_per_neuron):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_neurons = n_neurons
        self.n_comp = n_compartments_per_neuron
        self.Rm = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(16.5))
        self.Cm = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(1.6))
        self.Ri = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(177.5))
        self.axial_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n_neurons, n_compartments_per_neuron-1))
    def forward(self, x, V_state):
        V_new = V_state.clone()
        V_new[:, :, 0] = V_new[:, :, 0] + x
        for i in range(1, self.n_comp):
            axial = self.axial_weights[:, i-1] * (V_new[:, :, i-1] - V_new[:, :, i])
            leak = -V_new[:, :, i] / F.softplus(self.Rm)
            dV = (axial + leak) / F.softplus(self.Cm)
            V_new[:, :, i] = V_new[:, :, i] + dV
        return V_new[:, :, -1], V_new
